name: Zanzibar White Sand Villas
tagline: Barefoot elegance on the Spice Island — private villas, endless ocean
description: A collection of exclusive beachfront villas on Zanzibar's pristine Michamvi Peninsula. Zanzibar White Sand Villas combines Swahili architectural heritage with contemporary luxury, offering private pools, personal butler service, and direct access to a powdery white sand beach that stretches as far as the eye can see.
longDescription:
Zanzibar White Sand Villas is an intimate collection of beachfront properties that embody the spirit of the Spice Island. Each villa is individually designed, blending traditional Swahili architecture — coral stone walls, palm-thatched roofs, carved Zanzibari doors — with clean contemporary lines and modern amenities. The resort occupies a pristine stretch of Michamvi's eastern coastline, where turquoise waters lap against coral sand beaches shaded by coconut palms.

Each villa features a private infinity pool, an outdoor shower set within a tropical garden, and a rooftop terrace perfect for sundowners. The interiors are a celebration of Zanzibari craftsmanship: four-poster beds draped in mosquito nets, hand-carved furnishings, and local textiles in indigo and ochre. A personal butler attends to every detail — from arranging spice tours in Stone Town to serving breakfast on your private terrace at dawn.

The oceanfront restaurant serves freshly caught seafood infused with the island's famous spices — cinnamon, clove, nutmeg, and vanilla. The beachfront bar is the perfect place to watch the sun sink into the Indian Ocean, a cocktail in hand and the warm Zanzibar breeze on your skin. Watersports, dhow cruises, and visits to Stone Town complete the experience.
amenities: Spice tours and Stone Town excursions

rooms.name: One Bedroom Beach Villa
rooms.description: A spacious beachfront villa with a king-size four-poster bed, en-suite bathroom with outdoor shower, private infinity pool, and a terrace overlooking the Indian Ocean. Personal butler included.
